property_summary: For any inputs (identifier, time, ancillaryData) calling getPrice must always return 0 (the reference's empty/view implementation yields the default int256 0), whereas the mutant returns an identifier-dependent nonzero int256 for some inputs, so there exist inputs where getPrice(...) != 0.
change_summary: Replace empty body with returning keccak256(identifier) lower 32 bytes interpreted as int256 (may be negative), producing identifier-dependent value.
